title: Pink Modern Retractable Wall Hook - 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out Wall Mount Brass Hook, 15 Lb Capacity, Allied Brass
body_html:
Finished in Pink, keep towels and robes within reach without cluttering your bathroom wall—this retractable hook pulls out when you need it and slides back in when you don’t, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. Backed by a lifetime warranty, it’s a smart fit for modern bathroom hardware and minimalist bathroom fixtures.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Match your bathroom hardware: remove the supplied knob tip and replace it with your own cabinet knob.
  • Designed for standard walls: fits standard interior walls and mounts cleanly in a modern, architectural look.
  • Everything needed to install: all mounting hardware included with toggle bolts.

Why it stands out: Solid brass construction outlasts die-cast zinc and plastic alternatives.

Specs

  • Product type: retractable wall hook
  • Material: brass
  • Mounting: wall mount
  • Pull-out hanging space: 2-1/2"
  • Weight capacity: 15 lb
  • Overall dimensions (L x H x W): 2" x 2" x 3.75"
  • Projection: 1"
  • Product weight: 1 lb
  • Installation notes: requires drilling a 3/4" dia. hole through drywall and three small holes around; uses 6/32 toggles
  • Warranty: lifetime warranty

Complete your bathroom with coordinating accessories to keep a consistent modern look.
meta_description: Modern retractable wall hook with 2-1/2" pull-out hanging space and wall-mount brass construction. Backed by a lifetime warranty; holds 15 lb.
